ablation: One group removed at a time from six elementary components plus exact residual; keep all other groups
positive_controls: All components including exact residual reproduce input
Full rank 144 reproduces input up to numerical error
Drop residual after six equals fixed rank six
numerical_correction: After the initial full-rank identity control failed under default LSQR tolerance, all SSA-only readouts use direct Cholesky; retain initial logs and audit both solvers. Neural parameters are unchanged.
scope: SSA input reconstruction before independent Ridge, not SSA recurrent forecasting
selection_rule: Report every prespecified rank and deletion; exploratory validation minimum is not a final tuned method
no_clean_ground_truth: Report input-change RMS as modification magnitude, not denoising accuracy
